# shhyydh

> Portfolio of shhyydh (Shahid) — the journey, the projects, and how to get in touch.

## What this site is

A personal portfolio telling the story of how I went from sketching ideas to building
production software — starting with the bezgoFresh startup, then a set of tools and
systems built for businesses.

## Projects

- [Operations Engine](/projects/bezgofresh/operations-bot): The automation bot that took bezgoFresh from manual WhatsApp juggling to a fully automated order-to-delivery workflow.
- [Vendor Control System](/projects/bezgofresh/vcs): The system that replaced bezgoFresh's phone-call-and-Spreadsheet vendor network with a live, real-time platform.
- [bezoFresh case study](/startup/bezgofresh): The full story of building bezgoFresh from idea to operating platform.
- [AuthEngine](/projects/auth-engine): A self-hosted service that delivers login OTPs over WhatsApp, replacing a broken manual SMS workflow.
- [Footwear management suite](/projects/footwear-suite): An operations suite for a footwear business.
- [Travel Agency suite](/projects/agency-suite): A live, self-contained operations system for a travel agency.
